03  Custos · fatura disponível e atualização da fonte

panels.description: Custos brutos, créditos aplicados e valor líquido da fatura mais recente para o projeto Website & APIs Core.

targets.rawSql:
WITH billing AS (
  SELECT invoice.month AS invoice_month, project.id AS project_id,
    service.description AS service_name, currency, cost,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.amount) FROM UNNEST(credits) c), 0) AS credit_amount
  FROM `billing_export.gcp_billing_export_v1_*`
  WHERE project.id = 'enterprise-core-prod'
), latest AS (SELECT MAX(invoice_month) AS month FROM billing)
SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%m/%Y', PARSE_DATE('%Y%m', invoice_month)) AS Fatura,
  currency AS Moeda, ROUND(SUM(cost), 2) AS Bruto,
  ROUND(-SUM(credit_amount), 2) AS Creditos,
  ROUND(SUM(cost + credit_amount), 2) AS Liquido
FROM billing WHERE invoice_month = (SELECT month FROM latest)
GROUP BY invoice_month, currency

panels.title: Resumo da última fatura disponível

panels.description: Dias desde a última atualização do export de custos da conta, medidos por export_time. Acima de 2 dias: atenção; a partir de 7: obsoleto.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  DATE_DIFF(CURRENT_DATE('America/Sao_Paulo'), DATE(MAX(export_time), 'America/Sao_Paulo'), DAY) AS dias_sem_atualizacao
FROM `billing_export.gcp_billing_export_v1_*`

panels.title: Defasagem do billing

panels.description: Detalhamento de custo por serviço na última fatura disponível do projeto.

targets.rawSql:
WITH billing AS (
  SELECT invoice.month AS invoice_month, project.id AS project_id,
    service.description AS service_name, currency, cost,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.amount) FROM UNNEST(credits) c), 0) AS credit_amount
  FROM `billing_export.gcp_billing_export_v1_*`
  WHERE project.id = 'enterprise-core-prod'
), latest AS (SELECT MAX(invoice_month) AS month FROM billing)
SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%m/%Y', PARSE_DATE('%Y%m', invoice_month)) AS Fatura,
  COALESCE(service_name, 'Outros') AS Servico,
  currency AS Moeda,
  ROUND(SUM(cost), 2) AS Bruto,
  ROUND(-SUM(credit_amount), 2) AS Creditos,
  ROUND(SUM(cost + credit_amount), 2) AS Liquido
FROM billing WHERE invoice_month = (SELECT month FROM latest)
GROUP BY invoice_month, service_name, currency ORDER BY Liquido DESC

panels.title: Custo por serviço · última fatura

panels.description: Até 12 meses de fatura a partir da última fatura disponível. Valores na moeda indicada, sem conversão.

targets.rawSql:
WITH billing AS (
  SELECT invoice.month AS invoice_month, project.id AS project_id,
    service.description AS service_name, currency, cost,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.amount) FROM UNNEST(credits) c), 0) AS credit_amount
  FROM `billing_export.gcp_billing_export_v1_*`
  WHERE project.id = 'enterprise-core-prod'
), latest AS (SELECT MAX(invoice_month) AS month FROM billing)
SELECT CONCAT(FORMAT_DATE('%m/%Y', PARSE_DATE('%Y%m', invoice_month)), ' · ', currency) AS Fatura,
  ROUND(SUM(cost + credit_amount), 2) AS Liquido
FROM billing GROUP BY invoice_month, currency ORDER BY invoice_month, currency

panels.title: Custo líquido por mês de fatura

options.content: **Como interpretar:** Sem dados ≠ zero. Cloud Run escala até zero quando inativo. Custos são históricos do BigQuery export e podem apresentar defasagem de dias. P95 de CPU/memória indica pressão de pico nas instâncias ativas.
